setting: walking down from the hospital at ten past eight, rain on the hood over the microphone, a bus pulling out halfway, his voice dropping out for a long stretch on the hill and starting again near the bottom
her kitchen close to midnight, coat still on, the tap dripping twice, one short laugh at herself and a sentence she does not finish
the fourth morning of a run of five, walking very slowly, breath close on the microphone, forty seconds of talking and then only footsteps, traffic and wind to the end
his kitchen on a Tuesday afternoon, a pan at a simmer, a knife going down on a board four times, the extractor fan under all of it
